nodes.description: Thymocytes require a surface TCRαβ to be positively selected, so the alpha-beta lineage cannot complete development. The gamma-delta lineage, which does not need TRAC, is unaffected and comes to dominate the peripheral T cell pool.

evidence.snippet: Both children also had manifestations of immune dysregulation, with autoimmune hemolytic anemia, eczema, hypereosinophilia, anti-lymphocyte antibodies, anti-TTG antibodies, low-titer ANA, and pityriasis rubra pilaris.

nodes.description: A homozygous TRAC variant, either a premature stop codon in the Ig-like or transmembrane domain or the hypomorphic splice allele at the last base of exon 3. The splice allele removes exon 3, stripping part of the connecting peptide and the whole transmembrane and cytoplasmic region. The bound molecular function is the only one GO annotates to TRAC, from an experimental report. It is narrower than the receptor's role, because alpha-beta T cells also recognise peptide on MHC class I, so read it as the gene's annotated activity rather than as a claim that only class II recognition is lost.

genetic_context.description: Germline homozygous TRAC variant. The three premature stop codons are complete loss of function; the recurrent splice allele is hypomorphic, so this node is tagged PARTIAL_LOSS_OF_FUNCTION to cover both rather than asserting complete loss for an allele the entry itself calls hypomorphic. The per-subtype distinction is carried by has_subtypes and by each variant record.

nodes.description: The clinical classification of the hypomorphic form: a predominant T cell defect with bacterial and viral infection and lymphoproliferation.

evidence.reference_title: Skewed TCR Alpha, but not Beta, Gene Rearrangements and Lymphoma Associated with a Pathogenic TRAC Variant.
evidence.snippet: In summary, all three children had shown clinical features of a combined immunodeficiency with bacterial and viral infections, lymphoproliferation (including lymphoma in one of them), associated with a dramatic reduction in the number of TCR-αβ + T cells and elevated numbers of TCR γδ + T lymphocytes.

nodes.description: Without an intact constant region the alpha chain cannot stabilise CD3 and the beta chain at the membrane, so no functional TCRαβ reaches the cell surface. Reconstituting TCRα-deficient Jurkat cells with each premature-stop allele fails to restore surface CD3ε, TCRβ or TCRαβ, or the CD69 activation marker.

nodes.description: Alpha-beta T cells carry conventional MHC-restricted help and cytotoxicity, so their absence leaves defective control of bacteria, mycobacteria and herpesviruses, and defective tolerance. The 2025 study settles a question the founding report had left open: alpha-beta T cells are not redundant, and the apparent protection seen in the first patients came from the residual TCRαβ their hypomorphic allele allowed.
